projection_policy.summary: Control-plane does not own the Figma top-level coverage SSOT. It only projects the coverage entries that require HTTP/SSE/OpenAPI/generated-client behavior.
projection_policy.top_down: When contracts coverage adds or changes required generated paths, update the control-plane API DSL/OpenAPI/generated client and this projection gate together.
projection_policy.bottom_up: When control-plane implementation discovers a path, cache, stream, or endpoint contradiction, fix local projection if the meaning is local; escalate to contracts if Figma coverage or business policy is wrong.

mirrored_supporting_tool_limitations.local_scope: Control-plane must not collapse the mirrored coverage to the single UI page when no-nodeId get_metadata under-reports the file page list.
Control-plane must not treat use_figma figma.fileKey=headless as the contracts coverage source identity.
forbidden_projection_effects: replace upstream file identity with headless

mirrored_supporting_tool_limitations.local_scope: Control-plane must not treat a current live timeout for page 42:3014 as proof that onboarding generated-client coverage disappeared, and must preserve the contracts-owned child_count=84 / known_inventory_count=83 split without redefining Figma top-level identity.
